cases.sentence: Когда царь Езекия услышал это, он разорвал на себе одежду и надел ___.
cases.translation: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth.
cases.explain: The direct object of the transitive verb надел uses the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он послал распорядителя дворца Илиакима, писарей и старших ___ в рубище к пророку Исаии.
cases.translation: He sent the palace administrator, scribes, and chief priests dressed in sackcloth to the prophet Isaiah.
cases.explain: The accusative plural shows the direct object - the priests being sent.

cases.sentence: Они сказали ему, «Так говорит ___ , сегодня день беды и наказания».
cases.translation: They said to him, "Thus says Hezekiah, today is a day of trouble and rebuke."
cases.explain: The subject of the reported speech uses the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Может быть, Господь твой Бог услышит все ___ Рапсака.
cases.translation: Perhaps the Lord your God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh.
cases.explain: The accusative plural shows the direct object - the words being heard.

cases.sentence: Господь предостерегал Израиль и Иудею через пророков и ___.
cases.translation: The Lord warned Israel and Judah through prophets and seers.
cases.explain: The accusative plural shows the direct object - the seers through whom warnings came.

cases.sentence: Так говорит Господь, не бойся того, что ты слышал, и не слушай ___.
cases.translation: Thus says the Lord, do not be afraid of what you have heard, and do not listen to these words.
cases.explain: The genitive case follows the negated verb "не слушай" (do not listen to).

cases.sentence: Когда Рапсак услышал, что царь Осирии оставил ___ , он вернулся.
cases.translation: When Rabshakeh heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he returned.
cases.explain: The accusative case shows the direct object of the transitive verb оставил.

cases.sentence: Езекия молился Господу, говоря, «О Господи, Бог Израиля, восседающий на Херувимах, лишь Ты, ___ над всеми земными царствами».
cases.translation: Hezekiah prayed to the Lord, saying, "O Lord, God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth."
cases.explain: The subject complement after the verb быть uses the nominative case.

reading.ru: Когда царь Езекия услышал это, он разорвал на себе одежду, надел рубище и пошел в дом Господа.
reading.question: How did King Hezekiah respond when he heard the Assyrian threat?
options: He tore his clothes and put on sackcloth
reading.correct: He tore his clothes and put on sackcloth
reading.explain: The text describes how Hezekiah tore his clothes and put on sackcloth as a sign of distress and prayer.

reading.ru: Они сказали ему, «Так говорит Езекия, сегодня день беды, наказания и бесчестия».
reading.question: What did the officials tell Isaiah about the situation?
options: Today is a day of trouble, rebuke, and disgrace
reading.correct: Today is a day of trouble, rebuke, and disgrace
reading.explain: The officials conveyed Hezekiah's message describing the dire situation.

reading.ru: Когда приближенные царя Изекии пришли к Исаии, тот сказал им, «Скажите своему господину». Так говорит Господь, не бойся того, что ты слышал.
reading.question: What message did Isaiah give to Hezekiah?
options: Do not be afraid of what you have heard
reading.correct: Do not be afraid of what you have heard
reading.explain: Isaiah delivered the Lord's message telling Hezekiah not to fear the Assyrian threats.

reading.ru: Вот я пошлю в него такой дух, что когда он услышит одну весть, то будет вынужден вернуться в свою страну, а там я поражу его, и он падет от меча.
reading.question: What did the Lord promise to do to the king of Assyria?
options: He would be struck down by the sword in his own land
reading.correct: He would be struck down by the sword in his own land
reading.explain: The Lord promised that the Assyrian king would return to his country where he would be struck down.

reading.ru: Синахериб получил весть, что Тергака, царь Куша, идет на него войной.
reading.question: What message did Sennacherib receive?
options: The king of Cush was coming to fight against him
reading.correct: The king of Cush was coming to fight against him
reading.explain: The text states that Sennacherib received news that Tirhakah, king of Cush, was marching against him.

reading.ru: Езекия молился Господу, говоря, «О Господи, Бог Израиля, восседающий на Херувимах, лишь Ты, Бог, над всеми земными царствами».
reading.question: What did Hezekiah affirm in his prayer?
options: That only God is sovereign over all the kingdoms of the earth
reading.correct: That only God is sovereign over all the kingdoms of the earth
reading.explain: Hezekiah affirmed in his prayer that only God rules over all the earthly kingdoms.
